comparisonRules.raw: SHA256 of the Git blob compared with the original build receipt
comparisonRules.lineEndings: Only CRLF to LF; binary and invalid UTF-8 files never normalized

limits.repository: git-listed paths in the declared source scope, checked before and after compilation
limits.bundler: discovered input set and file bytes checked before and after final compilation
limits.generated: explicit virtual files, model data and effective settings frozen for both passes
limits.buildPlugins: explicitly named entry files; transitive runtime reads are not fully inventoried
limits.environment: effective build settings only; unrestricted environment is not captured
limits.targetRuntime: managed by Bun; separate target runtime artifact is not inventoried
